description: Add a person to a team group by email. An account is created when there is none. The new account gets a password of its own, which only the invitation letter shows (with a one-time link that signs the person in); the answer's `invitation` says what was mailed. Never tell anyone a password. move_from_other_groups=true takes the person out of every other group and resets their individual roles (a full move into this group).

move_from_other_groups.description: Remove the user from all other groups and reset their individual roles (default false)

send_email.description: Mail the invitation letter to a NEW account (default true). false: nobody is told a password — the person sets their own from the sign-in page.

name: add_user_to_team_group
